description: This source file defines a Gradle plugin named 'AndroidRoomConventionPlugin' that automates configuration of Android Room and KSP plugins within a Gradle project. It sets up extension configurations for Room and KSP, specifying schema directories and arguments, and manages dependencies related to Room implementation and compiler.

classes.name: AndroidRoomConventionPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that applies Room and KSP plugins to a project, configures their extensions, and manages dependencies.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: The method called to apply the plugin to a Gradle project; it configures plugins, extensions, and dependencies for Room and KSP.
